question: Who is the author of the work ‘Kadambari’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banabhatta**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kadambari is a romantic novel **written in **Sanskrit**.

 
 
• The book describes the affairs of two sets of lovers through a series of incarnations.
 
• Both works were left unfinished, the second was completed by the author’s son, Bhusanabhatta.
 
 
 
• **Banabhatta **is the author of Kadambari.
 
• He was the **court poet of Harsha** who wrote **his biography called Harshacharita**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
